description: Permanently deletes one of the signed-in player's saved rosters, by an id from list_my_rosters, and ends any loan of it to a friend. Battles it was fielded in keep their own record. It cannot be undone, so confirm the roster's name with the player first; set_roster_archived hides a list without losing it. Requires mcp:write.
name: delete_roster
title: Delete my roster
